checks.claim: a reader who substitutes the observed arm risks, and the observed odds ratio read off them, into the closed form obtains 16.6 percentage points where the correct figure is 19.8
checks.published: 16.6 pp and 16% low (manuscript L79, one decimal)
checks.rounding_rule: one decimal for pp, whole per cent
checks.note: manuscript L79 prints 16.6 pp and "an underestimate of 16 per cent"; the unrounded values are 16.6107 pp and 16.1076 per cent, so the printed pair is correct under its own rounding. The working notes and the handoff packet carry 16.60 pp and 16.1 per cent, which overstate the printed precision of the same two quantities; the discrepancy is 0.01 pp and does not change the argument, but the manuscript form is the one to carry forward

checks.claim: the same construction applied to a 25.8 per cent disagreement
checks.note: manuscript L124; 10.6 per cent maps below the threshold and 25.8 per cent maps above it, which is the argument of the paragraph
